part.text:
Fixed `Stringable` default trimming to include the NUL byte (`"\0"`), restoring parity with PHP’s native `trim`, `ltrim`, and `rtrim` behavior when no explicit character list is supplied.

Validation:
- `./vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Support/SupportStringableTest.php --filter "test(Trim|Ltrim|Rtrim)$"`: passed, 3 tests.
- Direct `Str::of(" \0 ")->trim()` parity check against native `trim()`: passed.
- Full `SupportStringableTest` run reaches an unrelated existing error: missing `Illuminate\Tests\Support\StringableObjectStub` in `testIs`.

Only `src/Illuminate/Support/Stringable.php` was modified.
